title: Explore far, direction 3 of 5: the never-read systems of one fifth of the map, the farthest first (gsc_0032 at 26 jumps), with a chain of up to three more on the way home
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-17 11:25 UTC for Suggi's order of 2026-11-17 (orders.log ENT-036, block ORACLE): for the turns of 11:15 and 15:15 UTC ten scouts explore as far out from our safe space as they can reach, in every direction, and read every system on the way and at the far end. The map (game/map/galaxy.tsv) opens from home in a fan of about 175 degrees; its never-read systems that stand on no other census list, no pirate stronghold among them, are cut into ten wedges of equal count by their angle from Nexus Prime, and each of five routes holds two neighbouring wedges, farthest first, the two wedges taken in turn. A never-read system is taken in list order (dispatch.py stalest_system); `chain` 3 then reads up to three more due systems within two lanes before the ship turns home, while the tank holds the way there and home (census.py). Fuel: 1 unit a jump and 1 a leg in a system (guidebook logistics.md); from Central Nexus or any station with fuel on this list the longest way to a system of the list and home is 58 jumps, against a tank of 95. Systems whose station sells no fuel are left out, because a census that docks stays there.
